svg.title: MASH biopsy results: drug vs placebo, in separate trials
svg.desc: MASH biopsy results: drug vs placebo, in separate trials. Steatohepatitis (MASH) resolved, fibrosis not worse: Wegovy 2.4 mg (ESSENCE, 72 wk) 62.9% vs placebo 34.3%; Rezdiffra 100 mg (MAESTRO-NASH F2-F3, 52 wk) 29.9% vs placebo 9.5%; Rezdiffra 80 mg (MAESTRO-NASH F2-F3, 52 wk) 25.7% vs placebo 9.5%; Tirzepatide 15 mg (SYNERGY-NASH phase 2, 52 wk) 62% vs placebo 10%. Fibrosis improved 1+ stage, MASH not worse: Wegovy 2.4 mg (ESSENCE, 72 wk) 36.8% vs placebo 22.4%; Rezdiffra 100 mg (MAESTRO-NASH F2-F3, 52 wk) 28.9% vs placebo 17.3%; Rezdiffra 80 mg (MAESTRO-NASH F2-F3, 52 wk) 26.5% vs placebo 17.3%; Tirzepatide 15 mg (SYNERGY-NASH phase 2, 52 wk) 51% vs placebo 30%. Tirzepatide is not approved for MASH. Rezdiffra figures are the F2-F3 reanalysis of MAESTRO-NASH.
